product_overview: A comprehensive Loan Management SaaS platform tailored for Zambian lending operations, supporting loan applications, approvals, repayments, borrower management, and regulatory compliance with integrations for CRB and PMIC.
core_goals: Automate end-to-end loan lifecycle from application to repayment.
Support configurable loan products with customizable terms, fees, and eligibility.
Enable secure borrower verification including KYC, CRB, and PMIC checks.
Provide robust role-based access control with audit trails and encrypted storage.
Offer scalable multi-tenant SaaS architecture with tenant-level configuration.
Integrate notification services including SMS, email, and push notifications.
Support legal tracking including loan-related court cases and lawyer assignment.
Deliver insightful dashboards and reporting tools for financial monitoring.
key_features: Home page with loan features and call-to-action for loan applications.
User authentication with login and registration via Supabase.
Multi-step loan application form capturing personal, employment, and document details.
Pre-qualification tool for eligibility checks before application submission.
Loan calculator for repayment and interest estimation.
User dashboard showing loan status, wallet balance, and quick actions.
Comprehensive admin dashboard for loan, borrower, repayment, and collections management.
CRB and PMIC integration modules for credit and loan guarantee checks.
Notification center supporting push, SMS, and email messages.
Role-based user management and staff administration.
Configurable loan products including terms, rates, fees, and eligibility rules.
Multi-tenant SaaS features with subscription and usage tracking.
user_flow_summary: Borrowers register and authenticate via secure login.
Borrowers use loan calculator or pre-qualification to assess eligibility.
Borrowers complete multi-step loan application with required documents.
Admin reviews applications including CRB and PMIC compliance checks.
Upon approval, loans are disbursed to borrowers and tracked via dashboard.
Borrowers make repayments manually or via bulk processing with receipt generation.
Admins manage legal cases and write-offs related to loans.
Admins configure loan products, system settings, and manage staff roles.
validation_criteria: All user authentication and registration flows function securely with MFA support.
Loan application captures complete and valid user and document data.
CRB and PMIC integrations perform accurate eligibility and compliance checks.
Loan product configurations apply correctly in calculations and application flows.
Repayment processing generates accurate schedules and receipts.
Role-based access control enforces permissions for all user roles.
Audit logs capture all critical user and system activities.
Multi-tenant SaaS features isolate tenant data and support subscription tracking.
Notification services deliver timely and accurate communications.
Legal and collections modules track cases and automate workflows effectively.
